description:
Kim Doha is hopelessly in love with his senior from the same department, Kim Haje. In fact, “love” doesn’t even cover it—he’s been shadowing Haje like a stalker for nine years straight, just to never miss a single move. 

*“Sunbae! I’ve loved you since 8 years, 11 months, 22 days, 14 hours, and 36 minutes ago!!”*

Doha dreams of finally confessing his feelings after graduation in the most romantic way… But then, he hears a shocking announcement.

*“I’m graduating early!”*

A school without Haje means nothing to him.

*“Sunbae, please! Don’t graduate yet!”*

Can Doha manage to graduate together with Haje and pull off his long-awaited confession?

[Original Webtoon](https://www.bomtoon.com/detail/dontgraduate)
